parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall metal shelving units filled with cardboard boxes. In the foreground, a large metal cage pallet loaded with goods is wrapped in plastic. A forklift is partially visible on the right. The floor is concrete, and lighting fixtures hang from the ceiling.

objects.label: metal cage pallet
objects.observation: Large rectangular metal cage with grid pattern, containing stacked items. Wrapped in clear plastic. Positioned centrally in the foreground. Contacts concrete floor. Partially obscures background shelves.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes of various sizes stored on high shelves. Some have green labels. Located behind and above the cage pallet. Occluded by cage and shelving structure.

objects.label: metal shelving
objects.observation: Tall industrial metal shelving units extending vertically and horizontally. Supports boxes. Located throughout the background. Appears freestanding.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift partially visible on the right side of the frame. Its mast and part of the body are seen behind shelves. Contacts floor. Unclear if operational.

objects.label: plastic wrap
objects.observation: Clear plastic wrap covering the top and sides of the metal cage pallet. Reflects light. Taut over contents. Attached to cage edges.
